note: The candidate's preview-chrome and retirement strings that change before production, each with its replacement or removal and the bead that makes the edit. scripts/delivery/copy-inventory.mjs locates every one by file and line in classic's Git objects (the frozen import revision and the candidate branch head) and in this repository's shell, and writes inventory/retirement-copy.json, which the candidate edit set (fm-ww4) and the monorepo copy beads read. Draft wording rules: old GUIDs, results and links are not preserved; no new share URLs exist; the operator controls timing, so no fixed date unless the operator sets one; operation limits and CPU/WebGPU/mobile guidance match the chosen artifact; classic self-host Compose is described in Help only, never as a primary recovery link.

strings.replacement: faq "How does facemorph.me work now?" — Everything happens here on your device: no server makes your faces. The old server and its API have been retired; links and results from the old site no longer open, and there are no share links for new results (save the image or video instead).
strings.note: No fixed date and no 'while we test' promise; the operator controls timing.

strings.find: faq "Is there an API I can self-host?"
strings.replacement: faq "What happened to the old API?" — It has been retired. Its source stays at github.com/check-face/checkface for anyone who wants to run it themselves; Help describes the classic self-host setup. Bugs in this app belong in a GitHub issue.
strings.note: The checkface.facemorph.me/api link goes: that host is retired.
